subject: Ignore::matched
prompt: In the ignore crate, the crate-private method Ignore::matched (crates/ignore/src/dir.rs) decides whether a path is ignored. If it changed behaviour, which of the following would behave differently through any chain of calls: (a) public methods of the ignore crate's exported types, including trait methods those types implement (such as Iterator::next), and (b) functions defined in crates/core/main.rs? Production code only: leave out tests, examples and benchmarks. List only entries from (a) and (b), not the intermediate private helpers. Name free functions as module::function using the file's module name (for example main::run), and methods as Type::method.
